name: welcome_parent
description: Sent to a parent or carer when their parent portal login is created from the pupil's contacts.
subject: Your {school_name} parent portal login
body: A parent portal login has been set up for you so you can follow {pupil_first_name}'s time at {school_name}:
their timetable, homework, attendance, grades, reports, library books, clubs and school events.
One login covers all of your children at the school.
Please change your password after you first sign in, and never share it.
If you weren't expecting this e-mail, or have any problems signing in, please contact the school office.

placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
